external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer. Authentication uses an email address, password, and session cookie; there is no second factor.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and uses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payer is not required to sign in.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console from the support office network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application that authenticates users, serves billing and payment pages, manages invoices, enqueues render jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app performs tenant filtering itself, uses one database account for all companies, and saves every field received by the invoice edit form.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The administrative console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console is reachable only from the support office network.

processes.name: payment page
processes.description: The page that displays an invoice, the company name, and bank details to a payer without requiring sign-in.
processes.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
processes.notes: The text does not explicitly state whether the payment page is a separate process from the billing app.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: The renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by the job.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security, and the app connects with one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue holding PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state the queue technology or its protection.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket containing rendered invoice PDFs stored under company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The customer user signs in to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.notes: There is no second factor for admins or viewers.
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password, and session cookie

data_flows.name: use app

data_flows.name: open payment page

data_flows.notes: The payer is not asked to sign in.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The email transport is not described.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: serve payment page
data_flows.description: The billing app serves the payment page with invoice, company name, and bank details.

data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether the payment page is implemented as a separate process.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: query invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and writes tenant records in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database
data_flows.notes: The app adds the company filter to each query itself and uses one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, and company IDs

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: consume render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Render job containing company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: The service credential is shared across companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Support-agent account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Subsequent actions are recorded against the customer user rather than the support agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and identity

data_flows.name: record user actions
data_flows.description: The billing app records actions performed through an impersonated customer session in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Actions attributed to the customer user

trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary; each customer company is a separate tenant.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform hosting the shared billing app, database, and PDF bucket.
